# [Launched] Generally Available: Connect to AKS clusters using Azure Bastion

## What Changed

Azure Bastion integration with Azure Kubernetes Service is now generally available. Customers can establish a secure tunnel from their local machine through Azure Bastion to an AKS cluster API server. The integration enables customers to use standard Kube

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This may change the workload security posture or required controls.
